subcompetencies.name: Critical Thinking for Diagnosis and Therapy

level_1: Lists a differential diagnosis for common clinical presentations

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common patient safety events

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination

level_4: Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems

level_1: Describes basic health payment systems, including government, private, public, and uninsured care, as well as different practice models
Describes basic elements needed to transition to practice (e.g., contract negotiations, malpractice insurance, government regulation, compliance)
level_2: Describes the key components of documentation for billing and coding
Uses shared decision- making in patient care, taking into consideration costs to the patient
level_3: Describes how working within the health care system impacts patient care
Identifies resources and effectively plans for transition to practice (e.g., information technology, legal, billing and coding, financial, personnel)
level_4: Documents the key components required for billing and coding
Advocates or leads change to enhance systems for high-value, efficient, and effective patient care
level_5: Analyzes how personal practice affects the system (e.g., length of stay, readmission rates, clinical efficiency)
Participates in advocacy activities for health policy

level_1: Demonstrates how to access and use available evidence, and incorporate patient preferences and values into the care of patients with routine conditions

level_4: Critically appraises and applies evidence, even in the face of uncertain and/or conflicting evidence, to guide care, tailored to the individual patient
level_5: Coaches others to critically appraise and apply evidence for patients with complex conditions; and/or participates in the development of guidelines
